text: Rice, per hundred grams: three sixty-five dry, one thirty cooked.
Fifty grams of dry rice soaks up about ninety grams of water, and weighs about one hundred forty.
Water adds weight, not energy: still about one eighty calories, spread over more grams.
Weigh it cooked but log the dry number, and you'd count nearly three times too much.
Match the label to the rice on your scale: dry with dry, cooked with cooked.
